quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets you run, climb, and reach for things. It is also the one found attached to your torso: two that grip and two that carry you, but it is NOT your lungs!
quests.question: Limbs
quests.hint: Hint: You stretch these out for a jumping jack.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Limbs are your arms and legs, working together as a team!
quests.funFact: Every jumping jack stretches all four of your limbs out wide.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found halfway between your hip and your ankle -- but it is not your calves!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: You bend these when you sit in a chair.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: You bend your knees every single time you sit down.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found between your neck and your hips. It is also the one that gets covered up by a t-shirt, but it is NOT your collarbone!
quests.question: Torso
quests.hint: Hint: A t-shirt covers this part of you.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Torso is the name for the middle of your body, made up of your chest, back, and tummy!
quests.funFact: A t-shirt is made to cover your torso, from your shoulders to your waist.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you scrunch down low when you feel grumpy -- but it is not your nose!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: You raise these when you are surprised.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: You can make dozens of expressions just by moving these.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that catches tiny bits of dust before they reach your eyes -- but it is not your nose!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: They grow along the edge of your eyelids.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: You have upper and lower eyelashes on every eye.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to stand tall and jump high. It is NOT your toes!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear shoes and socks on these!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Your feet help you balance so you do not fall over.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we blink to keep clean and safe. It is NOT your teeth!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you blink them!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: You blink your eyes thousands of times every single day.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the biggest, strongest part of your whole leg. It is also the one you pat after running a fast race, but it is NOT your heels!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: They are the top part of your legs!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: The biggest, strongest muscle in your body is in your thigh!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found below your waist, above your thighs. It is also the one you rest your hands on when you stand like a superhero, but it is NOT your toenails!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: Your legs connect to your body right here!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Your hips hold one of the biggest joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that opens wide when you yawn. It is also the one you might feel moving when you talk out loud, but it is NOT your chin!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: It moves up and down when you chew!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Your jaw has one of the strongest muscles in your entire body!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found under your skin, all over your body, not your nostrils!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They get stronger when you exercise and play.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: You even use tiny muscles in your face just to smile.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we trim carefully to keep our toes short and tidy. It is also the one found at the very end of your toes, but it is NOT your fingers!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: They are hard and grow at your toe tips!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Toenails grow more slowly than fingernails do!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we trim carefully to keep our fingertips short and tidy. It is also the one found at the very end of your fingers, but it is NOT your knuckles!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: They are hard and grow at your fingertips!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Your fingernails grow faster than your toenails do!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that curves around and protects your brain, like a helmet. It is also the one found inside your head, just under your skin and hair, but it is NOT your heart!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: Think about this: It protects your brain, like a natural helmet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Babies' skulls have soft spots that harden as they grow.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you count when you play a counting game with your feet. It is NOT your calves!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have ten, and they wiggle inside your shoes!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Your big toe helps you balance more than any other toe.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found between your chest and your hips. It is also the one you wrap a hula hoop around when you play, but it is NOT your back!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: Your belt goes around this part!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: You bend at your waist every time you touch your toes!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that fills up with fresh air every time you take a big breath. It is also the one found inside your chest, on either side of your heart, but it is NOT your skin!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: Think about this: There are two, right beside your heart.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Your right lung is a little bigger than your left one.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that curves around your chest, like a protective cage. It is also the one that protects your heart and lungs, which sit safely inside it, but it is NOT your joints!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: Think about this: They protect your heart and lungs.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: You have twenty four ribs, twelve on each side.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found on the underside of your foot, inside your shoe. It is also the one that gets tickled if someone touches it gently, but it is NOT your legs!
quests.question: Soles
quests.hint: They are the bottom part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: The soles of your feet have thicker skin than almost anywhere else on your body!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that shuts tight when you fall asleep at night, not your chin!
quests.question: Eyelids
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They cover your eyes like tiny curtains.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Blinking spreads a thin layer of tears to keep your eyes comfortable.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that can feel very sore if you bump it on a table, not your kneecap!
quests.question: Shins
quests.hint: Here's a tip: The bone here is very close to your skin.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: Your shins are the front part of your lower leg.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found between your hand and your elbow -- but it is not your arms!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: A watch or bracelet wraps around these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Your wrists let your hands twist, wave, and turn easily.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that shows where you were once connected to your mother before you were born, not your neck!
quests.question: Belly Button
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Every single person has one, right in the center of their tummy.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Your belly button shows where you were connected to your mother before birth.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that flares open wide when you breathe in deeply, not your gums!
quests.question: Nostrils
quests.hint: Here's a tip: There is one on each side of your nose.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: Your nostrils can flare open wider when you take a big breath.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you rise up onto your tiptoes. It is also the one that helps you jump up high off the ground, but it is NOT your knees!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: They are the back of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Your calves help push you up onto your tiptoes!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you hold up high to say 'great job' without saying a word -- but it is not your arms!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Each hand has just one, and it is short and strong.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: A thumbs up is a friendly way to say 'great job' around the world.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that has a tiny dip in some people, called a dimple -- but it is not your cheeks!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: You rest this on your hand when you think.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Some people have a small dimple right in the middle of it.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you turn to look left and right. It is NOT your belly button!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is between your head and your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Giraffes have very long necks, but yours works the very same way.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wears a hat when it is cold outside. It is NOT your cheeks!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is the very top part of you!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Wearing a helmet on your bike keeps this part extra safe.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you pat gently when you feel proud of yourself -- but it is not your hips!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: It is between your shoulders and your tummy.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: You can feel your chest rise and fall every time you breathe.
